policy: solar_kpno_kurucz2005_corrected: kpno_solar_atlas is registered telluric_required=no on basis 'line_selection', so tellurics are handled by per-line clean-line selection over 9 enumerated bands (RYA-460/786), not by a correction stage. telluric_applied=applied. caveats: Fixed diagnostic partitions are not isolated oxygen EWs or blend identifications. No errors/covariance or optimization. Local controls never replace immutable baseline. Model-guided anchors remain incomplete-opacity diagnostics.
